messages:
Nina: quick sync on compact-queue + logical lanes experiment.
Omar: hey, short bullets pls.
Nina: sure:
- goal: get small-request p99 back under 60ms while keeping pack efficiency >= 85%
- approach: logical lanes inside a shared enqueue + per-lane reservation tokens + microbatch fastpath
Priya: metrics we need: lane.enqueue_rate, packer.batch_fill_pct, lane.token_usage, late_join_delay_ms histogram
Nina: rollout plan: start canary 10% traffic with packer_mode=soft_fence, reserve tokens=16
infra-bot: canary scheduled for 1748893600, will route traffic slice 10% to experiment cluster.
Omar: what about warmup? KV cache must survive packing. we should avoid evict-on-enqueue.
Priya: agree. eviction policy = hysteresis_lru. only evict when global reserve < 0.2 for 5s.
Nina: fallback: config gate packer_mode=off triggers graceful-drain -> 2s drain + switch back to per-tenant queues.
Omar: ok. Priya please add telemetry spans to the packer API so tracing shows pack/unpack events.
Priya: will do.
Nina: OK i'll write a short RFC note and post by EOD.
